VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The agent's self-report alone is insufficient to verify acceptance criteria satisfaction. While the report claims all 102 tests pass and describes the fix, there is no independent evidence (CI logs, test output, code diff, or artifacts) to corroborate these claims. The acceptance criteria explicitly requires that "all 102 tests pass," which demands objective verification, not self-attestation. Without CI logs, test results, or code review artifacts, there is no way to independently confirm the fix works or that regression tests were actually added and passing.
